action_items.description: Fixed 3 pre-existing test artifacts that had drifted from the app, not app bugs: (1) backend tests (test_tscheck_seo_tags.py, test_tscheck_service_schema.py, test_tscheck_business_identity_schema.py) used a JSON-LD regex requiring an exact '<script type="application/ld+json">' opening tag; the app now correctly emits 'id="arcturus-structured-data"' before the type attribute (the fix described in seed_facts), so the regex was loosened to match any attribute order - all 71 backend tests now pass. (2) contact-prefilled-enquiry.mjs asserted the query-string mailto pattern against the wrong testid (contact-email-link, which is intentionally the plain visible email address) instead of contact-email-button (the actual prefilled-draft CTA) - corrected and now passes. (3) Removed leftover .backup scratch files from the checks directory.
